There are many people who don’t share this sentiment, but I have an appreciation for when a fanfic is so separated from canon that it could’ve easily been its own original novel, and yet the author was only ever going to put that much energy into it if their favourite characters got to be there

I think there’s a difference between “the author stripped the media of everything it had to replace it with something easy” and “the author thought up a concept they really really like and are bestowing it upon the character like a medal”

For most of human history, you could say “I am going to take Gilgamesj / Odysseus / King Arthur / Laosheng* /etc” and give him a completely new story, maybe in a completely different setting" and it would be considered just as valuable as a work of fiction with ‘original’ characters. That wasn’t 'fan’ fiction, that was just fiction.

The idea of the individual genius that has to build a completely new setting with new characters and a new plot from scratch is a very recent invention and a very European invention and it has greatly reduced the spectrum of what can be considered 'real’ art.

(*ok, a character archetype isn’t exactly the same as a character, but it’s another example where taking cues from a pre-established story telling tradition is appreciated and encouraged)

The very idea of “intellectual property” is and always has been antithetical to the way we communicate and share knowledge. No one can own a character or a setting or an idea, and we all know that. Copyright laws don’t exist to protect you or your unique ideas, they exist to enforce the existing power structure.

YES! And so is the idea of the individual genius.

Every time I see a post on here about how difficult it is to write and how it’s hard to write dialogue when you only want to do world building or it’s hard to write world building when you only want to do dialogue or it’s hard to see where the story should go next I want to shake people and go IMAGINE IF YOU DID NOT NEED TO DO THIS ALONE.

Because you really. do not. need to. do this. alone! And not just writing either. Painting, pottery, sculpture, everything. Art can be collaborative and it will usually be better art and more fun to make.

I am asking genuinely and without ulterior motive. This is not a trap, and any informed answer will be welcomed:

Does the use of the word 'novel’ (which simply means “new,” of course) to describe a particular format of written fiction - does that have anything to do with the advent of the expectation of originality described above?


I’m not an etymologist so I had to look this up and it looks like the word 'novel’ for a story is very old, 500-ish years, and from what I can find it does come from the word for news and used to mean something like 'a short story’.

But the idea that such a story should be

entirely

 original in all aspects (characters, plot, dialogue, etc) and could not borrow anything substantial from previous stories, is much more recent.

Though copyright law is probably the biggest culprit, literacy probably does have something to do with this too. When most people could not read, most stories were read aloud or performed as plays. Familiar characters or familiar plots are useful in such a setting because you can skip some of the set up and get right to the storytelling.

Shakespeare plays are obvious examples. They’re full of historical characters and often used a familiar plot from an existing play that Shakespear did not invent. The fun for the audience was often not in a completely new story, but in Shakespeares’ twist on a familiar character and/or the plot. (This is also how good fan fiction works.)

It’s worth noting that our current cultural idea of a 'new’ story is genre specific and has culturally accepted exceptions. Putting familiar characters in movies and TV series is considered more socially acceptable, especially if they’ve been recycled before. If you choose a public-domain character like Sherlock Holmes, you can put him in new adventures and make a successful TV show out of it without being side lined as 'fan fiction’.

But your Sherlock Holmes work is unlikely to be considered high art, no matter how good the story, because our modern concept of high art requires an entirely new creation, new plot, new characters, etc. Shakespeare is only considered high art because he’s not held to …

author: Austin Corona
title: The bipartisan energy bill tearing the climate movement apart
content:
In order to solve climate change, you have to do two things — stop burning fossil fuels, and build clean energy to replace them. The last few decades in the United States have witnessed a long back-and-forth over which of the two goals is more important, and over how to achieve either of them. Is it more important to pass a carbon tax, or subsidize electric vehicles? To block a new oil pipeline, or build a lot of solar and wind? 


On this question, the coalition known as the climate movement has fractured into two broad groups. On one side, there are activists, lawyers, and environmentalists, who tend to focus on blocking and reducing fossil fuel use. On the other, there are renewable energy companies and policy wonks, who tend to focus on building more clean energy.


These factions have clashed in the past, but over the past week a kind of civil war has erupted between the different elements of the climate movement. The inciting incident was the release of the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act, or BAAJA, a long-awaited Senate bill that is designed to enable the construction of more power plants, transmission lines, and gas pipelines. The bill does this by weakening some of the nation’s bedrock environmental laws, speeding up the timeline for government agencies to issue permits, and making it harder to cancel projects that have already gotten federal approval. 


For climate-conscious supporters of the bill, it’s better for the planet to build a lot of clean energy even if it means some fossil fuels get built as well, and even if they cause some damage to the environment on the way. Supporters of the effort argue that if the U.S. builds out new clean capacity, it will be easier to wean off fossil fuels, which are the primary cause of global warming and all its myriad consequences. Opponents say that’s a Faustian bargain, one that will jeopardize tribal nations, other marginalized communities, and endangered species.


“It is definitely exposing a potential fault line between the environmental community and clean energy interests,” said Representative Jared Huffman, a Democrat who represents Northern California, in an interview with Grist. 


Representative Jared Huffman, a Democrat from California, is skeptical of the Senate permitting reform bill.


Photo by Andrew Harnik / Getty Images


BAAJA is the product of months of bipartisan negotiation between four members of the Senate committees focused on energy and the environment. The two Democrats in the talks were Sheldon Whitehouse of Rhode Island and Martin Heinrich of New Mexico, who are both climate hawks and clean energy advocates. The Republicans were Mike Lee of Utah and Shelley Moore Capito of West Virginia, who are advocates of fossil fuels and critics of environmental regulation. Despite their ideological differences, the four senators managed to reach a compromise on a

sprawling 400-page bill

 with hundreds of individual provisions. 


The so-called “four corners” reached a deal just before Congress left for its fall recess, and the Senate will not return to take up the bill until after the midterm elections. The bill has not even made it through committee yet, and it also faces an uncertain fate in the House of Representatives. The next few weeks will see a scramble of lobbying as supporters and opponents of the bill try to sway senators and representatives for or away from the bill.


So far, at least, the builders seem to have more influence than the blockers, at least within the climate movement. President Donald Trump has spent the last two years

repealing


most


federal


climate policy

 and blocking the development of new clean energy, and many climate advocates seem willing to accept an imperfect deal rather than hold out hope of fixing Trump’s damage after he leaves office.


“It’s a lot easier to prevent things from being built than to build things, and that applies both to fossil fuels and to renewables,” said Zeke Hausfather, a climate expert at the science nonprofit Berkeley Earth, who also directs climate research for the tech company Stripe. “I don’t want us to run roughshod over any community, but we also can’t give everyone a veto for an issue as important as climate change. So ultimately, we need to strike a balance there.”


The case in favor: Build more

author: David Swanson
title: Activists Abused By Israel Return to New Freedom Flotilla Mission
content:
By Elizabeth Murray,

Washington Report on Middle East Affairs

, October 8, 2026


A NEW FREEDOM FLOTILLA

, led by the aptly named

Tenacity

, set sail from Bristol, UK in September and headed for Gaza in yet another attempt to break Israel’s siege and blockade of Gaza.


A significant percentage of the ship’s passengers and crew—whose countries of origin include Denmark, Norway, Spain, Ireland, France, the United Kingdom, the United States and Palestine (currently residing in Sweden)—have been kidnapped, detained and tortured by Israeli soldiers on previous Gaza-bound solidarity missions. Nevertheless, they are determined to challenge Gaza’s isolation.


Captain Tomás Alberto Moraté Serna, who hails from Spain, is the captain of the

Tenacity

. He was kidnapped, brutalized, tortured and deported by Israel in April 2026. He explained that he is back for the same reasons he joined the Gaza mission in the first place: “I am not happy with what I see in the world, and I need to do my part” to transform it.


Serna is primarily an environmental activist, but he is keenly aware that environmental and climate concerns overlap with ending wars. Knowing that Israel is daily murdering Palestinian men, women and children amid governments’ silence and/or complicity impels him to sail with the Freedom Flotilla once again. The flotilla’s slogan is “When governments fail, we sail.”


Colm Byrne, First Mate aboard the

Tenacity

, experienced violence at the hands of Israeli soldiers on a previous mission. He sails again “because there’s still kids being slaughtered and degraded,” he said. “And there’s no sign of it ending. This should not be happening in 2026.” Asked what he would say to the Palestinian people, Byrne, who hails from Ireland, stated: “I’d apologize for the Western world’s lack of response. I would let them know that the majority of the people of the world are on their side. We [the Gaza-bound Freedom Flotilla Coalition] represent the people.”


Another crew member who experienced Israel’s violent seizure of Gaza-bound boats in April 2026 said he has received several written death threats from Israel in the mail warning him that his life will be in danger if he is again apprehended by Israel on the high seas. For him, sailing again is an act of resistance against Israel’s crimes against humanity.


MY ROAD TO

TENACITY


For me personally, sitting at home during a genocide is not an option.


In the 1980s I was stationed in Amman, Jordan for two years, working as an editor for the U.S. government’s media translation office—then known as the Foreign Broadcast Information Service and later the Open Source Center.


As part of my duties, I would travel periodically to the U.S. Consulate in East Jerusalem (a diplomatic outpost which no longer exists) to collect the local Arabic language newspapers for translation. The trip usually entailed spending one or two nights in East Jerusalem.


It was during the time of the first Intifada, and most Palestinian businesses shuttered their doors at 1 p.m. in a nonviolent protest against the Israeli occupation. An eerie silence often pervaded those afternoons, when the streets were deserted.


In the early evenings I would often see armed Israeli soldiers chasing Palestinian children down the ancient cobblestone streets as clouds of tear gas hung in the air. I saw Israeli soldiers yanking a shopkeeper from behind his store counter and hauling him away in an armored vehicle. An Israeli policeman riding a very large horse once drew dangerously close to me as I walked in the park; he menaced other pedestrians in a similar fashion; and from my hotel window one morning, I awoke to the sight of a blackened Palestinian car in flames. (Israeli and Palestinian vehicles can be identified by their color-coded license plates.)


I visited several Palestinian families in their homes and learned about the Israeli poisoning of local water wells, the denial of housing permits and other cruelties designed to make life unbearable for Palestinians and encourage them to leave.


From that time, Palestine began to occupy a place in my heart.


My time among the Palestinians helped me to become more aware of the pro-Israel biases in the U.S. media and the militaristic mindset that prevailed among the government and think tank communities in Washington, DC. On one occasion I witnessed an entire room of Middle East experts giggling at the reference to Israel’s need to occasionally “mow the lawn in …

author: Jillian C. York
title: When No ID Means No Internet: Age Verification and the Right to Access Information
content:
This post was co-authored by

Sheila B. Lalwani

, a doctorate student and recent 

COMPASS Fellow

 hosted by EFF.


Age verification proposals are

often presented

 as a simple tradeoff: sacrifice a little privacy to better safeguard children online. But that framing overlooks a more fundamental question. What happens to people who cannot verify their age at all? This is particularly a problem when users are required to prove their age with identity documents.


Age-related restrictions are developing quickly around the world. While they differ radically across jurisdictions, in the past year, we’ve witnessed a sharp uptick toward mandatory age assurance for social media access but also for other high-risk digital services.


For example:


In late 2025,

 Australia

became the first country

 to implement a minimum age requirement for prohibiting children under age 16 from creating or holding social media accounts. 


India

passed the

Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act

 that includes mandatory verifiable parental consent and has undertaken ongoing discussions for social media restriction.


The United Kingdom

passed the

Online Safety Act


requiring age verification

 across a swath of services hosting content considered harmful to users under 18. More than half the states across the

U.S.


have enacted age verification laws

. 


An

EU Commission

’s expert

report

 recommends a ban on social media access for users under 13. It also recommends mandatory age verification for platforms to ensure that users are ‘age appropriate.’ 


The Access Problem 


Age verification laws that

are predicated on the necessity of

 users possessing a current passport, driver’s license, credit card, or similar documents proving their identity exclude critical sections of populations.  And this problem is global in nature:

Millions of people lack government-issued identification

 or encounter regular challenges to obtaining or updating it. 


Roughly

15 million adult U.S. citizens

 lack a driver’s license, and a further

2.6 million lack any government photo ID

; leaving large groups blocked from online content or services. The UK has a similar predicament: proof-of-age checks are often reliant on passports, driver’s licenses, or other recognized alternatives, which can pose unique challenges to people without these documents.


Much of the advocacy around age verification discusses the

privacy harms

 of age verification. Yet these measures also threaten something more fundamental: equal access to information and the ability to exercise the right to freedom of expression. 


Unfortunately, age verification systems foster unequal access to information and provide an asymmetric solution to find essential information, build community, and weigh in on public discourse. As governments and companies increasingly require users to prove their age before accessing online services, these individuals risk being excluded from large parts of the internet altogether. 


Effects on Global Majority Countries 


Age verification laws reshape who can speak, who can access information, and who gets excluded from the digital public sphere. In other words, age verification is not a neutral safety measure: it presents a structural barrier to disproportionately exclude certain groups—particularly those in the global majority—and alters the architecture of global online expression. Some of these groups are already marginalized offline, and age verification extends that exclusion into digital spaces.


For instance,

850 million people globally do not have ID

. Most of these individuals exist in primarily low and middle income countries in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. The World Bank

points out

 that many are members of marginalized groups and more than half of those lacking access to identity documentation also have children whose births have not been registered. Women are particularly vulnerable and are 8% less likely than men to have an ID. Other vulnerable groups, such as adults in low income countries, are less likely to have an ID when they fall below 25 years, as are those with a primary school education or less or those in rural areas. 


A

policy paper

 from EDRi points out that age verification laws provide quick tech solutions but overlook longstanding structural challenges and undermine the universality of the internet. The analysis finds that age verification laws have serious human rights implications and …

title: Veranstaltungen und Mobilisierung zum Basel18 Prozess
content:
Nach über zehn Jahren geht im November der Prozess gegen die Basel18 weiter – in zweiter Instanz am Basler Appellationsgericht.


Veranstaltungen: Am 29. Oktober in Basel und am 30. Oktober in Zürich (siehe unten)


Mobilisierung zum Gericht: Am 2. November und am 13. November vor dem Appellationsgericht Basel (siehe unten).


Auf Repression antworten wir mit Solidarität


Was bisher geschah: Am Abend des 24. Juni 2016 fand in Basel eine kleine, militante Demonstration gegen Rassismus, Repression und Stadtaufwertung statt. Dabei wurden unter anderem grosse Versicherungskonzerne, ein SVP-Büro und das Strafgericht angegriffen, die Polizei wurde mehrmals vertrieben, ein paar Einsatzfahrzeuge lädiert.


Im Anschluss wurden vierzehn Personen verhaftet, einige waren mehrere Monate in Untersuchungshaft. Es gab zahlreiche Hausdurchsuchungen, weitere Verfahren und schliesslich wurden 18 Menschen angeklagt. Daher der Name: Basel18.


Kollektivstrafen und Knast


Weil die Beweise fehlen, um einzelnen Personen konkrete Straftaten nachzuweisen, konstruierte die Staatsanwaltschaft eine Mittäter:innenschaft: Alle Angeklagten sollen nicht «nur» für Landfriendsbruch, sondern für alles, was bei dieser Demonstration passiert ist, verantwortlich gemacht werden – für jede Sachbeschädigung, für Angriff und Körperverletzung. Das ist ein Präzedenzfall. Ein Novum in der Schweizer Justiz.


So verurteilte beim ersten Prozess 2018 eben jenes Gericht, das bei der Demo angegriffen worden war, 15 der 18 Angeklagten zu im Schnitt zwei Jahren Gefängnis – teils auf Bewährung, teils nicht. Hinzu kommen immense Verfahrenskosten und Schadenersatzforderungen.


Der Fall der Basel18 steht damit für ein neues Mass an Repression. Gerade in Basel: Die Staatsanwaltschaft führte seither auch bei den Basel-Nazifrei-Prozessen Kollektivstrafen ins Feld; die Polizei verhindert, wie jüngst bei der palästina-solidarischen Demo im August, Proteste oft von Beginn weg.


Den «langen Sommer der Repression» nannte 2016 eine Broschüre die damalige Zeit. Ein Sommer der Solidarität war es aber ebenso – wie auch die darauffolgenden Jahre: Neue Freund:innenschaften entstanden, 2021 erschien das Buch «Abendessen 16:30», das


die U-Haft-Erfahrungen der Festgenommenen thematisiert.


Repression zielt darauf ab einzuschüchtern, zu zermürben und den Basel18 drohen seit nun über einer Dekade mehrere Jahre Knast. Und dennoch sind sie und ihr Umfeld kämpferisch geblieben. Umso entscheidender also, auch beim aktuellen Prozess deutlich zu machen: Solidarität hat viele Formen und sie überdauert die Mühlen der Justiz.


Lassen wir die Angeklagten mit den Prozesskosten nicht allein. Lassen wir uns nicht einschüchtern, stehen wir weiter für revolutionäre Ideen ein – kämpfen wir zusammen für ein gutes Leben für alle!


Veranstaltungen: Zehn Jahre her - reflektieren, diskutieren und weiter denken


Basel: 29.10.26 18:30 Einlass, 19:00 Uhr Beginn / Über dem Neuen Kino, Klybeckstrasse 247


Zürich: 30.10.26 18:30 Uhr Essen, 19:30 Uhr Beginn Veranstaltung, ab 22 Uhr Konzert und Party! Im Postsquat, Wipkingerplatz 7


Wir laden ein zur Reflexion von 2016 bis heute - was hat uns damals bewegt und was heute? Welche Rolle spielt Militanz in unserem Kampf um Freiheit und Gerechtigkeit? Was macht Repression mit uns als Einzelne und als Bewegung? Wie können wir Repression kollektiv gegenüberstehen?


Auf einen Input folgt eine Diskussion, in welcher das Publikum herzlich eingeladen ist, mitzudiskutieren.

Montag 2. November 7:30 und Freitag 13. November 7:45 (Urteilsverkündung) vor dem Appellationsgericht Basel, Bäumleingasse 1.

title: Григорий Петрович Максимов - Проблема насилия в революции
content:
Автор

: Григорий Петрович Максимов

Название

: Проблема насилия в революции

Дата

: 1927

Дополнительная информация

: Из: Голос труженика, №22, 1927


Источник террора


 Вопрос, который был подробно рассмотрен И. 3. Штейнбергом в его книге: «Нравственный лик революции», не случайно привлёк к себе огромное внимание.


 Не случайно, что этот вопрос в своё время неоднократно дебатировался в среде социалистической эмиграции. Не случайно, что этот вопрос занимает общественное внимание и теперь.


 Все это свидетельствует о чрезвычайном интересе к поставленной проблеме. Оно и понятно, разве можно пройти мимо той широкой практики насилия, проявлявшейся во время революции в самых различных формах, как в России, так и в Германии: интерес к поставленной проблеме обуславливается ещё тем обстоятельством, что насилие во всех его возможных и мыслимых формах, осуществлялось и продолжает осуществляться социалистами во имя достижения священной идеи социализма, носителями которой являются все передовые элементы современного общества.


 То разительное противоречие, которое обнаружилось во время только что минувших революций, между целью и средствами, методами осуществления, якобы вытекающими из самой цели, поставив под сомнение моральные основы социализма. Если бы не это, то, надо думать, что проблема насилия в революции не интересовала бы в такой мере, в какой она интересует сейчас все мыслящие элементы.


 Да, можно смело утверждать, что современные революции поставили под сомнение моральные устои, если не не всего социализма вообще, то его разновидности — государственного социализма. Возникает вопрос: не является ли насилие, в том числе и террор, внутренним содержанием государственного социализма? Не вытекает ли террористическая практика большевиков и немецких социал-демократов с логической неизбежностью из государственного социализма, как только он начинает осуществляться в жизни?


 И здесь честный вопрос о насилии разрастается до огромных размеров, до вопроса этики социализма, социалистической нравственности. Мы подходим здесь к той стороне социализма, на которую меньше всего обращалось внимания и котрой придавалось очень малое значение самими социалистами. Здесь кроется величайшая ошибка и величайший грех социалистов, ибо разгул террора в России и Германии (Носке-Шейдеман), есть неизбежное следствие этой печальной ошибки. И сейчас, когда вопросы насилия в революции с особой силой привлекают внимание, когда революционно-социалистическая практика наткнулась на разнообразные формы насилия и скомпрометировала на много лет идею социализма, я с сожалением констатирую, что ни автор упомянутой книги, ни его оппоненты на одном из его докладов в Берлине, в их числе и В.М. Чернов, ни Каутский, который ещё раньше поднял этот вопрос в своей книге о «Терроризме и коммунизме», не поднялись на настоящую высоту вопроса, а отделываются мелочами или просто смазывают вопрос и переносят его в плоскость отдельных частных вопросов, как террор, порицая его, но не ставя его в связь с общей системой нравственной философии социализма.


 Ведь проблема насилия в революцииесть вопрос практической нравственной философии, а если так, то вполне естественно, их нельзя рассматривать отдельно вне связи с теоретической нравственной философией. Прежде чем говорить о насилии, оправдывать его целиком или частично, или совершенно отрицать, необходимо установить на научном базисе ос новные моральные максимы, т. е. необходимо создать новую систему нравственности, той нравственности, которой проникнут социализм, но для которой он ещё не выработал системы. Потребность в выработке новой естественно-научной революционной системы нравственности, отличной от современной системы буржуазной нравственности, основанной на управлении и эксплоатации, отличной от системы Гоббса, по которой борьба всех — закон природы и где «человек человеку — волк», а также отличной от этики Канта и Нищие, между которыми бьётся современная мысль, чувствовалось давно, сожалению, очень немногими социалистами. Эта потребность чувствовалась Бакуниным, после поражения Коммуны, но болезнь, а затем смерть не позволили ему заняться специально этим вопросом. Тем не менее свою работу «Кнуто-Германская империя» он в значительной мере посвятил вопросам нравственности, о чём он сам говорит в тексте этой книги. Затем эту потребность чувствовал Кропоткин. В письме к Атабекяну (2-5—20 г.) он пишет: «Я взялся за этику, потому что считаю эту работу безусловно необходимой»… «в такой разработке, теперь, когда …

title: From Hierarchical Organization to Networked Democratic Organization, Organizational Renewal of the Left in the Digital Age
content:
Rezgar Akrawi: It is no secret that the left in many countries of the world has seen a decline in recent years. There are many reasons for this decline, objective and subjective, yet organizational structure and the forms of work and leadership have played a large part in it. I therefore believe that this stage requires a gradual shift from a hierarchical structure to a horizontal one, in which the base, the new generations and women have the greatest role in shaping policies and choosing leaders, and in which the leadership supports the base, backs it and coordinates its work.


Author


Rezgar Akrawi


رزكار عقراوي


    Submitted by

rezgar2

 on October 8, 2026


Organizational Renewal of the Left in the Digital Age


From Hierarchical Organization to Networked Democratic Organization


Rezgar Akrawi


”Freedom is always and exclusively the freedom of those who think differently.” Rosa Luxemburg


How We Run the Party Today Reflects How We Will Run Society Tomorrow


This text starts from the conviction that a left party is a miniature of the society it seeks to build and to run, and that its bylaws give an early picture of the kind of administration it would offer if it came to lead the state.

 The way decisions are made inside the party, the place of the rank and file in making them, the limits on the powers of the leadership and the way it is elected, and the degree of respect for dissenting opinion all give the masses a practical answer to an essential question. Will power in the society we aspire to rest in the hands of the masses themselves and under their continuous oversight, or will it be concentrated in the hands of limited bodies, however good their intentions?


To take one example, a party whose rank and file elect its leadership and hold it to account, in which positions rotate and the right of the minority to express itself openly is protected, offers a working picture of a state in which the people elect those who govern them and hold them to account, in which power changes hands and the rights of the opposition are protected.

Hence the importance of bylaws that embody, starting today, the values of democracy, participation, transparency and rotation that we promise society for tomorrow.


The idea for this text came from a debate now under way in the Iraqi left, after the Iraqi Communist Party put its draft bylaws up for public discussion ahead of its Twelfth National Congress.


What I put forward, however, is a view of left organization in general, and it concerns all parties and organizations of the left, in the Global South and in the West alike. I write from personal experience in the ranks of the left movement since the 1980s, in which I knew clandestine work and the strict centralism it imposed, a centralism that was at the time a condition of survival and whose historical necessity I fully recognize.


The question carries particular weight in the Middle East and the countries of the Global South, where many organizations of the left still reproduce organizational mechanisms that were shaped under conditions of clandestine work and persecution by dictatorial regimes. Those mechanisms served the forces of the left in their time, and some of their elements may remain necessary wherever repression persists, yet many of them have become outdated and unable to keep pace with the times. Left parties in Europe and North America face similar questions of their own, from declining membership to the drift of the new generation away from traditional party forms.

Capitalism, meanwhile, renews its mechanisms of work and its forms of organization by the minute, and it may prove hard to confront it with organizational structures that have not developed adequately for decades.


The renewal I am calling for rests on four pillars.


First:

 The various socialist ideas and experiences, past and present, approached through an open and critical reading that benefits from their strengths and achievements and learns from their shortcomings and failures, at the intellectual and the organizational level alike.


Second:

 Knowledge, which is now open and widely accessible and no longer the preserve of a particular group that monopolizes the interpretation of reality.


Third:

 Rights consciousness, which has advanced greatly on questions of freedom of expression, full equality for women, human rights, the rights of minorities, the environment and personal freedoms.

author: Sarah Lane
title: Where you’ll find Equality Now at the 89th Ordinary Session of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR) in Dakar, Senegal
content:
8th October 2026


Where you’ll find Equality Now at the 89th Ordinary Session of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR) in Dakar, Senegal


7 min read


News and Insights


Africa


The African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR) is a key institution within the African Union responsible for promoting and protecting human rights across the African continent. Its Ordinary Sessions, held biannually,  play a crucial role in advancing the human rights agenda in Africa.


During the 89th Ordinary Session of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR) in Dakar, Senegal, Equality Now will host side events, read our statement, engage in submitted shadow reports review, and host side events.


Here is where you can find us.


Events


                                        Monday, 12 October 2026


Defining a Positive Cultural Context: Women’s Rights and the Rise of Anti-Rights Movements in Africa


Article 17 of the Maputo Protocol provides for women’s right to live in a positive cultural context and the right to participate in the determination of cultural policies, moving beyond seeing women as merely beneficiaries of cultural protection and recognising them as individuals who contribute to the creation, interpretation, and transformation of culture.


The Centre for Human Rights (University of Pretoria), Equality Now and SOAWR will convene a panel discussion, bringing together experts and practitioners to discuss the impact of regressive women’s rights movements on Article 17, in light of the growing prevalence of anti-rights movements, and the pivotal role of Article 17.


Date: 12th October 2026


Time: 13:00 – 15:00 GMT


Location: King Fahd Palace Hôtel (Dakar, Senegal)


                                         


Strengthening CSO Resilience in the Face of Rising Anti-Rights and Anti-Gender Pushback to End Harmful Practices


Convened by

Equality Now, Amref Health Africa and End FGM/C Network Africa

, this side event will examine the growing anti-rights and anti-gender backlash threatening progress towards ending harmful practices such as FGM/C and child, early and forced marriage.


The discussion will bring together civil society, human rights defenders and other stakeholders to share practical strategies for strengthening resilience, countering backlash and advancing accountability through strategic litigation, digital advocacy, coalition-building and regional and continental mechanisms.


Date: 12th October 2026


Time: 12:30 – 14:00 GMT


Location:

Sama Hotel (Salle Casamance

), Dakar, Senegal


                                        Tuesday, 13 October 2026


Analysis of the gender responsiveness of the AU Nationality Protocol


Convened by Equality Now and the SOAWR Coalition on the margins of the 89th Ordinary Session of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights, this side event will present findings on an analysis of the gender responsiveness of the  AU Nationality Protocol.


The AU Nationality Protocol provides for equality in acquiring, transmitting, changing, and retaining nationality for men and women, embedding gender equality within a broader non-discrimination and statelessness-prevention framework. However,  it has some limitations on gender responsiveness, such as clawback clauses on the grounds of national legislation, national security, public order, and an explicit provision on conferment of nationality to foreign spouses on an equal basis for both men and women.  


Date: 13th October 2026


Time: 13:00 – 15:00 GMT


Location: Sama Hotel (Dakar, Senegal)


Transportation will be provided from King Fahd to Sama Hotel and back. Transportation will leave King Fahd at 1:00 pm (GMT). Lunch will be provided.


                                        Wednesday, 14 October 2026


Promising Practices in Ensuring and Strengthening Access to Justice for Survivors of Sexual and Gender-Based Violence in Africa


This side event during the 89th Ordinary Session of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights showcases promising practices and specialised mechanisms drawn from ten African countries to close the gap between progressive legal frameworks and effective, survivor-centred access to justice for survivors of sexual and gender-based violence. author: Izzy Knowles
title: Don’t Let Barbie Out of the Glovebox – An OCD Account
content:
W

hen I was in fifth grade, I convinced myself I was pregnant. I had never even kissed a boy. A slight stomachache after guzzling down my morning glass of milk became the beginning of early-onset morning sickness. A fleeting urge for bacon at a time that wasn’t breakfast suddenly meant that I was experiencing a full-fledged pregnancy craving. I would look around the band room and stare at the other girls in my class, wishing so deeply I was them so I wouldn’t have to deal with this phantom baby.


The following summer, I was certain I had developed a powerful addiction to making my little sister’s Barbie doll, a foxy brunette called Nancy, do back walkovers. During a sixteen-hour road trip from Chicago to Vermont, I picked up Nancy and mindlessly began kicking her leg back over her head and onto my thigh. As I flipped her in circles over and over, I started to worry I would never be able to stop. I pictured a future bound to this motion alone, where the only escape would be a bedridden life with my hands permanently restrained to my sides. Terrified of the fate ahead of me, I cried and pleaded with my mother to hide the Barbie in the glovebox, out of sight.


By the end of sixth grade, I convinced myself that I was going blind (I couldn’t see in the dark), that my lung had collapsed (I realized I could breathe manually), that I was dying of cancer (I discovered a mole on my chest), and that I was passionately suicidal (I got too close to the edge of my father’s balcony). I slept with the lights on, went to the emergency room when I felt my breaths were too shallow, and spent every other night on a mattress in my mother’s room on the off chance I’d sleepwalk to the kitchen and stab myself in the heart.


Of course, none of these fears came true. My imagined due date rolled around with no contractions, I didn’t suffer from any Barbie-related withdrawals, and I learned to trust the doctors who told me I was healthy. But despite the high turnover rate of my neuroses, I lacked the essential concoction of insight and perspective to realize they would eventually fade.


For most of my life, I chalked up my intolerance for uncertainty as a symptom of being a “worrywort.” My parents seemed to tie my perpetual doom to my capacity for empathy, telling me that I “just cared too much.” My middle school therapist, an older woman who sat me down with a mound of clay and a mug of lemonade each session, labeled my disposition as “irrational.” Though I can’t quite disagree with them, my concerns were operating along an axis far more penetrating than worry alone.


By the time I was a seasoned high schooler, the themes of my fears had morphed from absurd to abhorrent. My wide-eyed childhood irrationality turned inward, shifting into existential questions aimed at navigating the liminal space between truth and delusion. I cycled through the more universal dilemmas:

Is this all a simulation? Are dreams our reality? Is everything you see, everyone you love, merely a figment of your imagination?

 Each question would surge me into obsessive contemplation, driving a wedge between the life around me and the doubt that threatened to squash it.


Sometime in my sophomore year amidst a weed-induced existential rant with my best friend, a question of my

own

 mortality crept out from the depths of my “what ifs.”

Am I immortal?

 It was a fleeting idea that turned over in my brain one too many times—causing that deep sense of doom to slither out and turn a hypothetical into an actuality.


Later that night in the safety of my bathtub, I gave myself an ultimatum: to conquer this new reality before I got out of the tub. I leaned back, avoiding the faucet, and questions and doubts and guilt over my questions and doubts seemed to cloud over the colorful splotches behind my eyelids. The waterline moved up and down my thighs and I wondered how I would cope with seeing everyone I love die over and over again. I decided that if I was right, and my life never ended, I would put myself in a sort of anesthetized state—like Woody Allen did in the movie

Sleeper

.


The next bout of fears shifted my focus from mortality to morality, casting doubt on the substance of my personhood.

Are your morals authentic or manufactured? How can you trust your ethics if they are determined by a world that is simulated, synthetic, or nonexistent? Are you a sociopath? Are you a deviant?

 The urgency to internalize the weight of these questions escalated as they …

title: La fine del genocidio è la fine del sionismo
content:
Riportiamo l’intervento introduttivo del convegno svoltosi mercoledì 7 ottobre presso l’Università di Torino, organizzato dal coordinamento Torino per Gaza, dal titolo “La fine del genocidio è la fine del sionismo”. In questa introduzione vengono toccati molti nodi politici fondamentali che aiutano a capire quanto sia mistificato il dibattito attorno alla resistenza palestinese da gran parte dei media main stream.


L’evento è stato partecipato da più di 300 persone che hanno ascoltato gli ospiti invitati in presenza e in collegamento. Alla fine del convegno si è dato vita ad un corteo attorno al polo unversitario del campus Einaudi letteralmente circondato dalle forze dell’ordine. Infatti sono state schierate una ventina di camionette, un idrante e centinaia di poliziotti in assetto antisommossa e in borghese. La governance universitaria si è piegata a questa ennesima militarizzazione del dissenso, i cui effetti ricadono su chiunque viva lo spazio universitario. In un momento in cui vengono approvati decreti che vogliono bollare come antisemita ogni voce in disaccordo con le politiche genocide di Israele crediamo sia ancora più importante dare spazio alle ragioni che animano la solidarietà al popolo palestinese e alla sua resistenza. Buona lettura!


Buonasera a tutti e tutte,


Vogliamo ringraziarvi moltissimo per essere qui oggi con noi e, soprattutto, per essere qui ad ascoltare i nostri ospiti. Con noi oggi abbiamo Adel, della rete Samidoun, è una rete internazionale di organizzatori e attivisti impegnati a promuovere la solidarietà con i prigionieri palestinesi nella loro lotta per la libertà. Atef, studente palestinese, e Miriam Abu Daqqa, attivista femminista palestinese e dirigente del Fronte Popolare per la Liberazione della Palestina (FPLP). 


Prima di dare la parola a loro, vorremmo spendere due parole sull’importanza di essere qui oggi e sull’importanza di un dibattito di questo tipo all’interno dell’università. 


Questo in cui ci troviamo è un luogo di sapere, di pensiero critico ma il sistema di guerra e di israelizzazione delle società sta rendendo le università un veicolo propagandistico a favore del genocidio. Le futili polemiche giornalistiche, non possono nei fatti impedirci di far emergere un’analisi completa che permette di leggere eventi come il 7 ottobre nella loro storicità ma soprattutto di assumere lo sguardo dell’oppresso e un approccio decoloniale per comprendere gli sconvolgimenti del presente.


Il sapere viene utilizzato per  mantenere una precisa torre d’avorio: quella del potere. 


Il sistema della formazione dentro cui veniamo educati, sin dai primi anni di scuola, ci insegna unicamente ad acconsentire, a stare zitti, a non interrogarci, ma soltanto a integrarci ad un sistema di sopraffazione e violenza.


Basti pensare che, ad esempio, in cinque anni di scuola superiore, nessun programma affronta davvero il colonialismo. Nessuno affronta la storia della schiavitù, della segregazione dell’Africa e della sua spartizione secondo gli sporchi interessi europei. 


a Nessuno viene insegnato che, tuttora, per avere un’Europa ricca e benestante (sempre per pochi) è necessaria una periferia, uno scarto, un luogo di lavoro, di sfruttamento e di povertà. E questo luogo viene rappresentato dai Paesi del Sud globale.


A Nessuno viene insegnato che gli Stati Uniti d’America hanno macellato e distrutto interi territori del Medio Oriente per il puro controllo delle risorse e del petrolio.


in virtù di questo appare chiaro che raccontare la verità è un compito sempre più nobile e sempre più difficile, soprattutto quando le aule vengono negate, i microfoni vengono spenti, e le voci vengono silenziate.


Il 7 ottobre 2023, il muro che ha confinato la popolazione di Gaza per oltre vent’anni si è aperto per la prima volta. È bene sottolineare come il 7 ottobre non sia stato l’inizio del genocidio, bensì l’inasprimento e l’innalzamento di uno sterminio che era già in corso a “bassa intensità”, da quasi ottant’anni. Non possiamo non leggere questa data come un evento che si inscrive all’interno di precise coordinate storiche, dentro un processo coloniale feroce e dentro un regime di apartheid. La strumentalizzazione di questa data è direttamente imputabile alla volontà di continuare questo genocidio, che ormai non riguarda più soltanto la Palestina, ma tutto il Medio Oriente.

author: infolibre
title: Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στους/τις 3 διωκόμενους/ες για την υπόθεση της 01/07 της Θεσσαλονίκης, Παρασκευή 9/10, 09.30, στα Δικαστήρια
content:
Κάλεσμα από την

Ανοιχτή συνέλευση αλληλεγγύης στα 3 προφυλακισμένα συντροφια για την υπόθεση της 01/07 στη Θεσσαλονίκη:


Στις 10/7, 2 συντρόφια και ένα ακόμα άτομο συλλαμβάνονται από την «αντι»τρομοκρατική, ενώ η τελευταία συνδέει τις συλλήψεις με πρόσφατο εμπρησμό. Παράλληλα πραγματοποιούνται, μετά από 16 χρόνια, συλλήψεις για την υπόθεση της Marfin. Επιπλέον την Πέμπτη 16/07 συλλαμβάνεται ένας ακόμα σύντροφος με τα κανάλια να τον συνδέουν με την υπόθεση της 01/07 της Θεσσαλονίκης και την αντιτρομοκρατική να εισβάλλει σπίτι του, πραγματοποιόντας έρευνα. Τα τρία συντρόφια προφυλακίζονται με τα μίντια να επιτίθενται στον αναρχικό χώρο και τη δικογραφία να παραμένει ανοικτή.


Δύναμη ως την λευτεριά στα συντρόφια μας, που είναι στα χέρια του κράτους.


Αγώνας, αυτοοργάνωση, αλληλεγγύη


Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στον προφυλακισμένο σύντροφο


Τα ξημερώματα της 1ης Ιούλη πραγματοποιείται τριπλή εμπρηστική επίθεση σε σπίτια πολιτευτών της ΝΔ στη Θεσσαλονίκη. Η μία απο αυτές οδήγησε στον, υπό αδιευκρίνιστες μέχρι στιγμής συνθήκες, θάνατο της Βάγιας Νέστορα, μητέρας της πολιτεύτριας με τη ΝΔ, Αφροδίτης Νέστορα. Η κυβέρνηση και τα μίντια, ως είθισται, άδραξαν την ευκαιρία εργαλειοποίησης του εν λόγω θανάτου πραγματώνοντας το προεκλογικό τους σόου. Ως συνήθως, στο στόχαστρο των ερευνών, βρέθηκε για άλλη μία φορά ο α/α χώρος, με τα μίντια να συντηρούν το αφήγημα της κυβέρνησης, παρουσιάζοντας τον αντιεξουσιαστικό χώρο ως τη μήτρα παραγωγής υπόπτων, προδικάζοντας την υπόθεση πρωτού αυτή φτάσει στα χέρια της αστικής δικαιοσύνης.


Εννιά ημέρες μετά, η αντιτρομοκρατική προχωράει στη σύλληψη του συντρόφου Χάρη Σ., της συντρόφισσας Γεωργίας Β. κι ενός ακόμα ατόμου, ενώ στις 16/7 συλλαμβάνεται και οδηγείται στη ΓΑΔΘ ο σύντροφος Αίμονας Τ., με μοναδικό στοιχείο ενοχής την ψευδομαρτυρία του τρίτου συλληφθέντα. Ελλείψει στοιχείων, παρά την άρνηση όλων των κατηγοριών και ενώ δεν δόθηκε το περιθώριο εξέτασης μαρτύρων υπεράσπισης από την ανακρίτρια, αποφασίζεται η προφυλάκιση των δύο συντρόφων και της συντρόφισσας, οι οποίοι οδηγούνται στις φυλακές Λάρισας, Δράμας και Κορυδαλλού. προκειμένου να ολοκληρωθεί το αναγκαίο αφήγημα κράτους-μίντια, περί της ύπαρξης τουλάχιστον τριών δραστών και να αποκατασταθεί η “κοινωνική ειρήνη”. Παράλληλα, τα ειδησιογραφικά ασκώντας άριστα την ποταπή δουλειά τους διαρρέουν φωτογραφίες της συντρόφισσας και του συντρόφου από τυχαίες κάμερες της πόλης, ποινικοποιώντας για ακόμα μία φορά τις συντροφικές και φιλικές σχέσεις εντός του χώρου. Φυσικά, ο πολιτικός χρόνος στον οποίο συμβαίνουν τα παραπάνω δεν είναι τυχαίος. Είναι εμφανές πως το ελληνικό κράτος έχει εισέλθει σε καθεστώς πολεμικής προετοιμασίας και επομένως σε καθεστώς θωράκισης απέναντι σε εσωτερικούς εχθρούς. Εχθροί οι οποίοι κατασκευάζονται και παρουσιάζονται με μαεστρία από τον κρατικό μηχανισμό, με στόχο τον αποπροσανατολισμό του δημόσιου διαλόγου από τους υπαίτιους της εκμετάλλευσης και εξαθλίωσης των ζωών μας.


Δεν μας εκπλήσσει η χυδαία στάση μπάτσων, δημοσιογράφων και δικαστών απέναντί μας, αλλά ούτε και η αναξιοπρεπής μεταχείρηση και ο ευτελισμός του θανάτου ενός ατόμου της “δικής τους πλευράς”, με τα στελέχη της ΝΔ να παίζουν ένα ντροπιαστικό και συνάμα θλιβερό θέατρο στα κανάλια, προκειμένου να ασκήσουν συναισθηματικές πιέσεις στο κοινωνικό σύνολο. Οι τακτικές αυτές στοχεύουν διαχρονικά στην αποδυνάμωση και διάσπαση του α/α χώρου μέσα από ψεύδη και βρώμικα πολιτικά παιχνίδια.


Απέναντι σε όλη τη λασπολογία, τη χυδαιότητα και τη στοχοποίηση του αντιεξουαστικού κινήματος απαντάμε πως όχι μόνο τρόμο δεν αισθανόμαστε, αλλά τώρα, πολύ περισσότερο από ποτέ, μπροστά στην ολομέτωπη επίθεση που συλλογικά δεχόμαστε, δεν σκύβουμε το κεφάλι. Όσο προσπαθείτε να καταστήσετε κανονικότητα την υποτίμηση της ανθρώπινης ζωής, τόσο οι αγώνες μας θα μπαίνουν ανάχωμα στα σχέδιά σας. Στεκόμαστε πλάι στα συντρόφια μας με υπερηφάνεια, υψώνοντας τις φωνές μας ωστέ να μην σας αφήσουμε να ξεχάσετε πως οι δολοφόνοι είστε εσείς.


Καλούμε σε συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης εξώ από τα δικαστήρια, την Τετάρτη 07/10 όπου ο σύντροφος Αίμων Τ. καλείται για συμπληρωματική κατάθεση.

author: Λουκάς Σταμέλλος
title: Το Νήμα | Μαρφίν vol. 3: Οι φωνές των κατηγορουμένων
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Το Νήμα | Μαρφίν vol. 3: Οι φωνές των κατηγορουμένων


Τρεις άνθρωποι κατηγορούνται από την αστυνομία και διώκονται από την εισαγγελία με ασυνάρτητα «στοιχεία» για μια υπόθεση που ανασύρεται για τρίτη φορά, μετά από δύο αποτυχίες, μία παταγώδη και μία σιωπηρή.


Και σαν να μην έφτανε αυτό, αντιμετωπίζουν, επιπλέον, την άσκηση συμπληρωματικής δίωξης από την εισαγγελία για καθένα από αυτούς, με το γνωστό άρθρο 187Α, για τρομοκρατικές πράξεις.


Μιλήσαμε με τον Θύμιο, την Ελένη και τον Κώστα, που είναι προφυλακισμένοι για την υπόθεση «Μαρφίν», μέσω τηλεφωνικών συνεντεύξεων από τις φυλακές.


Παράλληλα, οι συνήγοροι υπεράσπισής τους, Θανάσης Καμπαγιάννης, Κώστας Παπαδάκης και Άννυ Παπαρρούσου μας κατατοπίζουν για το πώς εξελίσσεται αυτή η τρίτη απόπειρα της αστυνομίας να επαναφέρει την υπόθεση «Μαρφίν».


Την Τρίτη, 13/10/2026, αλληλέγγυοι καλούν σε συγκέντρωση συμπαράστασης, στις 10 π.μ., στα δικαστήρια της Ευελπίδων, όπου οι τρεις θα περάσουν εκ νέου από ανακρίτρια.

title: L’esperimento spagnolo. Le tante luci di un’epopea proletaria
content:
La Rivoluzione Spagnola è stato l’esperimento più avanzato nel superamento della società basata sulla proprietà privata e sul dominio del governo. Questa rivoluzione è stata soffocata dalle truppe nazionaliste guidate dal generale Francisco Franco il 1° marzo del 1939. I nazionalisti erano sostenuti da una coalizione internazionale di governi imperialisti guidata dal Regno Unito e dalla Francia, che ha appoggiato l’intervento militare della Germania e soprattutto dell’Italia.


Questa coalizione internazionale si è tradotta in un’interpretazione storica che ha condannato senza appello l’esperienza rivoluzionaria spagnola. Una condanna su cui concordano, sia pure con motivazioni diverse, gli storici reazionari, quelli liberali e quelli marxisti delle varie scuole.


L’esperimento rivoluzionario spagnolo, fin da quando era in corso, attirò su di sé le critiche delle componenti interclassiste, antiorganizzatrici e individualiste del movimento anarchico, critiche che spesso hanno messo in secondo piano il valore di quella esperienza.


Scopo di questo articolo è mettere in evidenza le conquiste del proletariato spagnolo, al di là degli errori e delle carenze che non inficiano i risultati raggiunti, e l’utilità degli insegnamenti provenienti dai settantasei anni di lotte che precedettero il 19 luglio 1936 per il proletariato di tutti i paesi, in marcia verso la rivoluzione sociale.


Mi limiterò ad alcune considerazioni. La prima, e la più importante, è che il modello organizzativo del proletariato spagnolo, basato su un’organizzazione politica anarchica e su un’organizzazione di massa autonoma da ogni partito e tendenzialmente unitaria, tanto che al suo interno convivevano diverse tendenze oltre a quella anarchica, ha sconfitto per tre volte il fascismo. La prima volta quando pose fine alla pratica del pistolerismo, cioè all’assassinio sistematico degli attivisti sindacali e dei militanti anarchici da parte di gangster assoldati dai capitalisti. Sotto i colpi dei pistoleros cadde anche Salvador Seguì, segretario della CNT (Confederación Nacional del Trabajo): Fu allora che esponenti del movimento anarchico e sindacale decisero di rispondere eliminando il capo della reazione antiproletaria, il cardinale Juan Soldevilla y Romero, arcivescovo di Saragozza. Un atto che seppe fermare la pratica del pistolerismo.


La seconda volta quando nel 1929 il dittatore Miguel Primo de Rivera fu costretto alle dimissioni e l’anno dopo cadde la monarchia. La terza volta quando il colpo di Stato dei generali contro la repubblica e il governo di fronte popolare, iniziato il 17 luglio 1936, fu sconfitto in gran parte della Spagna dalla pronta reazione popolare ispirata dalla Federacion Anarquista Iberica. Nel dibattito storico è stata spesso sottovalutata questa reazione: è stato sostenuto che, dal punto di vista militare, il colpo di stato sia stato sconfitto dallo schierarsi di alcune unità delle forze armate con il governo legittimo. Ritengo che proprio questo conferma l’importanza della reazione popolare, che ha creato il clima politico in cui i militari fedeli alla repubblica hanno potuto schierarsi con il movimento proletario.


Questa riflessione è tanto più importante se si pensa che negli stessi anni il fascismo si andava affermando, dopo l’Italia, in altri stati europei dove era presente un movimento operaio organizzato egemonizzato dalle componenti autoritarie come i partiti socialdemocratici e stalinisti. Le consecutive sconfitte del movimento operaio tedesco (1914 entrata in guerra della Germania, 1919 sconfitta della rivoluzione dei consigli, 1933 nomina di Adolf Hitler cancelliere del Reich) dimostrano l’incapacità dell’organizzazione autoritaria e burocratica di resistere alla reazione.


Un luogo comune, condiviso anche in ambito anarchico, è che lo stalinismo abbia sconfitto la rivoluzione libertaria in Spagna, provocandone la fine. In realtà lo stalinismo ha subito in Spagna una sconfitta da cui si sarebbe ripreso solo con la guerra mondiale.


Negli ultimi mesi del 1936 l’Unione Sovietica inviò ingenti aiuti alla Repubblica spagnola; questo ebbe dei contraccolpi nella situazione interna aumentando il peso del Partito Comunista, che assorbì le scarse forze socialiste in Catalogna dando vita al Partito Socialista Unificato della Catalogna, al tempo stesso estese la sua influenza sulla gioventù socialista, che si unì a quella comunista. Il partito comunista divenne il punto di riferimento della borghesia e di quanti …

author: Unknown
title: Radio Canut donne la parole aux lycéen·nes sur leur mouvement social
content:
Une semaine après le début d'un mouvement lycéen qui a gagné les rues de Lyon de manière impressionnante, des animateurices de Radio Canut ont fait chauffer leurs micros pour donner la parole aux lycéen·nes sur leur mouvement social, en passe d'embarquer toute une portion des travailleur·euses. Des entretiens fleuves aux reportages en passant par des textes d'analyse, les émissions

Minuit Décousu

 et

Mayday

 vous proposent 2h de Maynuit Daycousu pour amplifier les voix de la jeunesse.


Minuit Décousu #264 Sois jeune et casse tout

 

!


Au printemps dernier, on s'est lancé dans un double docu sonore sur

le mouvement contre le

CPE

 puis sur

celui contre la Loi Travail

. Deux mouvements majeurs pour les lycéen·nes et les étudiant·es de leur époque, à dix ans d'écart. Notre plan secret, c'était de faire une émission sur le grand mouvement social de la jeunesse de 2026. C'était écrit, le mouvement devait arriver, rien ne pouvait nous échapper : c'est la prophétie Minuit Décousu.


Cette semaine, on a donc tendu notre micro au

collectif autonome lycéen Rafal

, pour nous parler de la stratégie du mouvement, de la répression à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur des lycées, dont le but est de marquer les chairs, les esprits et les dossiers scolaires. On a aussi interrogé

des lycéen·nes qui organisaient leur premier blocage

, sur les effets que ça a sur leur politisation et sur la construction d'une

AG

 inter-lycéenne qui permet de reprendre du pouvoir quand on est délaissé de tous les espaces politiques qui nous concernent. En filigrane à travers l'émission, les lycéen·nes se positionnent contre l'adultisme et la fiction de manipulation du mouvement, et affirment leur volonté de construction d'un autre monde.


Minuit Décousu, c'est un fanzine radiophonique nocturne sur

Radio Canut

 (Lyon et alentours),

Radio Vassivière

 (Limousin) et

Cause Commune

 (Paris/

IDF

). Semaine après semaine pendant une heure, on en découd avec la nuit et on tire les fils de sons, de textes, d'archives et de voix qui s'entremêlent.


Mayday #259 La classe lycéenne

 

!


Le mouvement lycéen de ces derniers jours a surgi en plein marasme, désastre climatique tous les jours plus aigu, fascisation accélérée, mouvement social à l'arrêt et en une semaine il a bloqué la grande majorité des lycées, empli les rues, saturé l'espace médiatique et donné des idées aux travailleur-euses qui ne savaient plus par où reprendre la lutte.


Cette semaine Mayday donne donc

la parole à des dizaines de lycéen-nes rencontrées aux abords des lycées, dans les rues révoltées et les manifs déterminées

. Beaucoup de reportages et des voix qui nous parlent des conditions d'étude de la jeunesse, de la galère dans les bahuts de banlieue où tout a commencé, de la rage et de l'envie de se faire enfin entendre, avec aussi des débats animés, des désaccords sur les moyens de la lutte, des profs qui soutiennent et d'autres qui pacifient, des coups de gueule...


Mayday c'est tous les mercredis à 18h sur radio canut et aussi en rediffusion sur la Clé des ondes (Bordeaux), Radio Dragon (Mens), Radio Zinzine (Limans), radio Cause Commune (Paris et Ile de France), radio Méga (Valence), radio Larzac (causses et au delà), radio Grenouille (Marseille), JetFM (Nantes). Toutes nos émissions se réécoutent aussi ici ou sur les trucs de podcast :

https://audioblog.arteradio.com/blog/98875/mayday

author: Unknown
title: Yoksulluğa değil, savaşa bütçe: Savunma harcaması 2027’de yüzde 229 artacak
content:
Merkez Bankası’nın İstanbul Finans Merkezi'nde düzenlediği İstanbul Ekonomi Forumu başladı. Dünyanın farklı ülkelerinden merkez bankası başkanları ve üst düzey politika yapıcıların katıldığı forumun açılış konuşmasını Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek yaptı.


Konuşmasında küresel ekonomide yaşanan sorunlara değinen Şimşek, tedarik zincirlerindeki aksamalara, emtia fiyatlarındaki artışa ve yükselen enerji maliyetlerine dikkat çekti. Şimşek, ekonomik krizin kontrol altında olduğunu savundu.


Savunma harcamalarına yüzde 229 artış


Şimşek'in konuşmasında en dikkat çekici başlıklardan biri ise 2027 yılı bütçesine ilişkin açıklaması oldu.


Türkiye'nin caydırıcılığını güçlendirmeye devam ettiğini belirten Şimşek, çatışmaların yaşandığı bir dünyada savunma alanına yatırım yapılmasının zorunluluk olduğunu söyledi.


Şimşek, kısa süre önce hazırlanan ve TBMM'ye sunulması beklenen 2027 yılı bütçesinde savunma harcamalarının yüzde 229 artırılacağını duyurdu.


Türkiye'nin son 20 yılda savunma sanayisine önemli yatırımlar yaptığını söyleyen Şimşek, 1990'lı yıllarda dünyanın en fazla savunma sanayisi ürünü ithal eden beş ülkesi arasında bulunan Türkiye'nin bugün en büyük 10 ihracatçı arasına girmeye yaklaştığını ileri sürdü.


Savunma projelerindeki AR-GE büyüklüğünün 100 milyar doların üzerinde olduğunu belirten Şimşek, yaklaşık 1400 ürün geliştirme projesinin yürütüldüğünü de açıkladı.


2026’da Milli Savunma Bakanlığına ayrılan bütçe 822 milyar 930 milyon 177 bin TL’ydi.


Şimşek'in sözünü ettiği 2027 yılı için yüzde 229'luk artış doğrudan Milli Savunma Bakanlığı’nın bütçesine uygulanırsa kurumun ödeneği yaklaşık 2,71 trilyon TL’ye yükselecek.


Ancak Şimşek'in yüzde 229 artışla Milli Savunma Bakanlığı bütçesini mi, yoksa daha geniş kapsamlı savunma harcamalarını mı kastettiği bilinmiyor. Savunma ve güvenlik için ayrılan toplam kaynak, yalnızca bakanlığın bütçesinden ibaret değil.


Öte yandan Stockholm Uluslararası Barış Araştırmaları Enstitüsü’nün (SIPRI) 2025 verilerine göre Türkiye’nin askeri harcamaları son 10 yılda yüzde 94 artarak 30 milyar dolara ulaştı. Bu da Türkiye'yi dünya en yüksek askeri harcama yapan ülkeler arasında 18. sıraya soktu.


Ülkeler silahlanmaya 2025’te 2,9 trilyon dolar harcadı


27 Nisan 2026


86 milyon 92 bin kişilik nüfus düşünüldüğünde hükümet kişi başına yaklaşık 375 dolarlık (yaklaşık 18 bin 500 TL) askeri harcama yapıyor.


Milyonlarca kişi yoksulluk riski altında, çocuklar öğün atlıyor


Savunma harcamalarındaki artış açıklaması, Türkiye'de milyonlarca yurttaşın geçim sıkıntısıyla mücadele ettiği bir dönemde geldi.


Türkiye İstatistik Kurumunun (TÜİK) 2025 yılı Yoksulluk ve Yaşam Koşulları Araştırması'na göre nüfusun yüzde 27,9'u, yani yaklaşık 24 milyon kişi, yoksulluk veya sosyal dışlanma riski altında bulunuyor. Medyan gelirin yüzde 50'si esas alınarak hesaplanan göreli yoksulluk oranı ise yüzde 13. Bu da yaklaşık 11 milyon kişiye karşılık geliyor.


Çocuklarda ise tablo daha çarpıcı. TÜİK verilerine göre 0-17 yaş grubundaki çocukların yüzde 36,8'i yoksulluk veya sosyal dışlanma riski altında. Başka bir ifadeyle Türkiye'de her üç çocuktan birinden fazlası bu riskle karşı karşıya.


Aynı araştırmaya göre nüfusun yüzde 35,1'i, yani yaklaşık 30 milyon kişi, ekonomik nedenlerle iki günde bir et, tavuk veya balık içeren bir öğünün masrafını karşılayamıyor. Yurttaşların yüzde 19,6'sı ise evinin yeterince ısınma ihtiyacını ekonomik olarak karşılayamadığını belirtiyor.


"Her üç çocuktan biri yoksulluk riski altında”


13 Temmuz 2026


Öte yandan TÜRK-İŞ'in Eylül 2026 araştırmasına göre dört kişilik bir ailenin sağlıklı ve dengeli beslenebilmesi için yapması gereken aylık asgari gıda harcaması 37 bin 801 TL'ye yükseldi. Gıda dışındaki zorunlu giderleri de kapsayan yoksulluk sınırı ise 123 bin 130 TL'ye ulaştı.


2026 yılında net asgari ücretin 28 bin 75 TL olduğu düşünüldüğünde, tek asgari ücretle geçinen dört kişilik bir hanenin aylık geliri yalnızca gıda için hesaplanan açlık sınırının bile yaklaşık 9 bin 725 TL altında kalıyor.


Çocukların beslenme sorunu eğitim hayatına da yansıyor. Ekonomik İşbirliği ve Kalkınma Örgütünün (OECD) PISA 2022 araştırmasına göre Türkiye'deki 15 yaşındaki öğrencilerin yüzde 19,3'ü, yiyecek alacak yeterli para bulunmadığı için haftada en az bir kez öğün atladığını bildirdi.


Milli Eğitim Bakanlığının 2025-2026 istatistiklerine göre resmi okullarda yaklaşık 15,2 milyon öğrenci eğitim görüyor. Bu öğrencilerin tamamına yılda 180 gün boyunca ücretsiz bir …

author: Stelinsky
title: Οι θάνατοι στις φυλακές είναι κρατικές δολοφονίες (τοποθέτηση από τις έγκλειστες συντρόφισσες Μαριάννα Μανουρά και Δήμητρα Ζαραφέτα)
content:
Σε διάστημα τριών μηνών σημειώθηκαν δέκα θάνατοι κρατουμένων στις φυλακές του Αγίου Στεφάνου στην Πάτρα. Οι θάνατοι έλαβαν χώρα σε έναν χώρο εγκλεισμού με κοινό παρανομαστή τις σοβαρές ελλείψεις στην ιατροφαρμακευτική περίθαλψη. Δέκα άνθρωποι που έχασαν τη ζωή τους πίσω από τα τείχη, εκεί όπου το κράτος έχει τον απόλυτο έλεγχο πάνω στη ζωή και την καθημερινότητα των κρατουμένων. Η πρόοδος στην υγεία όμως δεν αποτελεί για το κράτος προτεραιότητα, αλλά αντιμετωπίζεται ως προνόμιο, ως κομμάτι της καλής λειτουργίας της εκάστοτε φυλακής. Ο Άγιος Στέφανος, όπως και οι περισσότερες φυλακές, δεν αποτελεί εξαίρεση.

Η έλλειψη μόνιμων ιατρών είναι ο κανόνας, ενώ κατά το παρελθόν έχουν χρειαστεί ακόμα και ομάδες εθελοντών γιατρών, προκειμένου να παρέχεται έστω και υποτυπώδης περίθαλψη στους κρατούμενους. Την ίδια απάνθρωπη αυτή συνθήκη, την ίδια ανεπαρκή ιατροφαρμακευτική περίθαλψη, δυσχεραίνει συνεχόμενα ο αυξανόμενος υπερπληθυσμός. Στον Άγιο Στέφανο, μια φυλακή χωρητικότητας περίπου 340 με 370 ανθρώπων, κρατούνται σήμερα γύρω στους 700. Είναι 700 άτομα, τα οποία δεν αρκεί να τραφούν και να στεγαστούν, αλλά πρέπει και να εξεταστούν, να έχουν πρόσβαση σε αξιοπρεπή ιατροφαρμακευτική περίθαλψη, σε γιατρούς, νοσηλευτική φροντίδα, ψυχιατρική υποστήριξη και σε νοσοκομείο όταν αυτό απαιτείται. Αντ’ αυτού έρχονται αντιμέτωπα με την ανυπαρξία κάθε είδους πρόνοιας, την έλλειψη υποδομών και ιατρικής φροντίδας, μια συνθήκη που μετατρέπει την υγεία από αναφαίρετο δικαίωμα σε προνόμιο που χρήζει διεκδίκησης.

Και ενώ οι ελληνικές φυλακές δεν προσφέρουν ούτε τα βασικά, βρίσκονται τα τελευταία χρόνια σε μια συνθήκη ακραίου υπερπληθυσμού. Ενός υπερπληθυσμού, αποτέλεσμα της συνεχούς αυστηροποίησης του ποινικού και σωφρονιστικού κώδικα, με την πιθανότητα φυλάκισης να αυξάνεται και της αποφυλάκισης να μειώνεται. Η εικόνα αυτή επαναλαμβάνεται και στις γυναικείες φυλακές της Θήβας. Με αφορμή τον πρόσφατο θάνατο συγκρατούμενής μας τον Αύγουστο, ήρθαν ξανά στην επιφάνεια οι σοβαρές ελλείψεις στην ιατροφαρμακευτική περίθαλψη.

Στη Θήβα δεν υπάρχει μόνιμος παθολόγος, η κάλυψη των αναγκών πραγματοποιείται από γυναικολόγο. Γιατροί άλλων ειδικοτήτων επισκέπτονται τη φυλακή κάθε τρεις μήνες, γεγονός που τους δίνει τη δυνατότητα να εξετάζουν μόνο κάποιες ελάχιστες από τις εκατοντάδες που έχουν αιτηθεί επίσκεψη. Παράλληλα, δεν υπάρχει εφημερεύον γιατρός, ενώ απουσιάζει και οργανωμένη ψυχιατρική πτέρυγα. Το τεράστιο αυτό κενό καλύπτουν οι ίδιες οι κρατούμενες, που αναλαμβάνουν να υποστηρίξουν η μία την άλλη, να φροντίζουν τις άρρωστες συγκρατούμενές τους και να καλύπτουν, όσο μπορούν, τα κενά ενός συστήματος που όφειλε να τους παρέχει τα απαραίτητα για μία αξιοπρεπή διαβίωση. Η παραπάνω συνθήκη αντικατοπτρίζει τη θέση του κρατικού και κατασταλτικού μηχανισμού απέναντι στους χιλιάδες κρατούμενους και κρατούμενες. Θέση που δεν είναι άλλη από την απόλυτη απαξίωση και αδιαφορία.

Οι ανεπιθύμητοι, οι ασυμβίβαστες, οι μικροπαραβάτες, οι τοξικοεξαρτημένοι και οι μετανάστριες πετάγονται κυριολεκτικά στη χωματερή του σωφρονιστικού συστήματος. Ένας πληθυσμός που προέρχεται κατά κύριο λόγο από το πιο εξαθλιωμένο κομμάτι της κοινωνικής βάσης, αορατοποιείται, αφήνεται στην τύχη του και στοιβάζεται στις ασφυκτικά γεμάτες ελληνικές φυλακές. Άνθρωποι αποκλεισμένοι βρίσκονται πίσω από τα κάγκελα των φυλακών, χωρίς καμία στήριξη ή βοήθεια. Στο πρόσωπό τους ξεδιπλώνεται η κυβερνητική στρατηγική περί πάταξης εγκληματικότητας και ασφάλειας του πολίτη, την ίδια ώρα που εφοπλιστές, πολιτικοί, βιομήχανοι χρήζουν ποινικής ασυλίας, παραμένοντας στο απυρόβλητο. Ο ιδιοκτήτης και υπεύθυνος για τη δολοφονία των πέντε γυναικών εργαζομένων του εργοστασίου Βιολάντα, κ. Τζιωρτζιώτης, ο βουλευτής και πρώην υπουργός Μάκης Βορίδης για την εμπλοκή του στο σκάνδαλο του ΟΠΕΚΕΠΕ, οι επιχειρηματίες Ντίλιαν, Μπίτζιος, Λαβράνος και Χάμου για την εμπλοκή τους στο σκάνδαλο των υποκλοπών, είναι μερικά από τα παραδείγματα που η αστική δικαιοσύνη γύρισε το βλέμμα της αλλού.

Προφανώς δεν περιμένουμε να βρούμε το δίκαιο στις δικαστικές αίθουσες, ούτε στοχεύουμε σε μια πιο αντικειμενική δικαιοσύνη. Είναι ξεκάθαρο εξάλλου πως ο θεσμός έχει δημιουργηθεί για να εξυπηρετεί κράτος και κεφάλαιο, για να διαιωνίζει την εκμετάλλευση και την καταπίεση, για να επιβάλλει την κρατική βία και τον έλεγχο. Η εναντίωσή μας στο δικαστικό και σωφρονιστικό σύστημα είναι αδιαμφισβήτητη.

Ξέρουμε όμως πως ως κρατούμενες αλλά και ως αναρχικές δεν θα μείνουμε με τα χέρια σταυρωμένα ενώ οι άνθρωποι στερούνται ακόμα και το βασικό …

author: Trojka
title: Relacja z demonstracji w Toruniu – Nasze ulice, wasze granice!
content:
W sobotę, 3 października, wspólnie wyszliśmy i wyszłyśmy na ulice Torunia aby zademonstrować swój sprzeciw wobec rosnących nastrojów ksenofobicznych i rasistowskich.


Demonstracja odbyła się dzięki zaangażowaniu

Toruńska Grupa Anarchistyczna

 w ramach ogólnopolskiej kampanii Nasze ulice – Wasze granice organizowanej przez

161 Crew

 i

Federacja Anarchistyczna


Start spod pomnika Mikołaja Kopernika próbowała zakłócić grupa “białych obrońców Europy” , którzy czekali na nas z banerem Defend Europe. Podjęli próbę zorganizowania kontry, która gdyby nie interwencja policji, skończyłaby się dla nich utratą baneru i resztek godności.


Garstka przestraszonych chłopaczków, wspierana przez kilku napinaczy jest dowodem na to, że hasła “White power” są cały czas obecne w publicznej przestrzeni.


I, mimo że wykrzykuje je banda sfrustrowanych neonazistów, to nie możemy zapominać, że są oni użytecznym narzędziem w ręku władzy, antagonizującym społeczeństwo. Społeczeństwo, które ma uwierzyć w to, iż osoby z doświadczeniem migracji są realnym zagrożeniem dla naszej pracy, dla marnej polityki socjalnej, zaś każda osoba w drodze stanowi bezpośrednie ryzyko dla naszego życia i bezpieczeństwa.


Skrajna prawica buduje swój kapitał polityczny na strachu i ten strach chciały narzucić nam osoby “kontrmanifestujące”. Oczywiście bezskutecznie – ponieważ demonstracja ruszyła i nie daliśmy się zablokować!


Idąc ulicami Torunia, w obecności Samba Rythms of Resistance, kierowaliśmy do mieszkańców i mieszkanek przekaz “Mamy tylko siebie, tu nie ważne są korzenie” “Bez granic, bez nacji, stop deportacji” “Solidarność naszą bronią” “Otwarte serca, otwarte granice”.


Jako ruch anarchistyczny sprzeciwiamy się dzieleniu ludzi na równych i równiejszych, sprzeciwiamy się tworzeniu gett dla osób innego pochodzenia, sprzeciwiamy się ograniczaniu swobody przemieszczania się i dostępu do rynku pracy, sprzeciwiamy się traktowaniu osób migrujących jako tanią siłę roboczą, która zdana jest na łaskę barbarzyńskich agencji pracy!


Demonstracja zakończyła się w Forcie Jakuba gdzie odbył się koncert zaangażowanego HH:


Profesor Ulicy, NMCP, Erick Havok oraz punkowa załoga z Torunia z trąbką – 8Kaw.


Zarówno sobotnia demonstracja jak i cała Kampania są dowodem na to, że nasza siła tkwi we wspólnocie, kulturze oporu i pomocy wzajemnej. Pokazaliśmy i pokazałyśmy, że na próby siania nienawiści odpowiadamy jeszcze donośniejszym głosem sprzeciwu.


Nasze ulice pozostaną wolne od ksenofobii, dopóki będziemy tworzyć je razem!


Do zobaczenia na kolejnych akcjach.


Nasze ulice – wasze granice!


#naszeulicewaszegranice
